subject: PO request and SKU-level line item clarification for CloudBeacon onboarding
messages:
From: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@cloudbeacon.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudbeacon.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: PO needed for onboarding + invoice details

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the startup credits — CloudBeacon is ready to finalize finance details for our Dedicated trial. Attached is our vendor W-9 and the initial invoice (Invoice_2026-03-28.xlsx). Our procurement team needs an issued PO number and confirmation of the spend cap before we can route payment.

Two small asks from AP: can you (1) confirm the PO number you'll assign, (2) confirm net30 payment terms and whether Redwood requires a specific remittance address on the invoice, and (3) provide a SKU-level breakdown or corrected line items if Redwood's billing needs the items split out by model/instance type (they prefer separate unit prices per compute SKU).

We'd like to avoid delays on the first bill. If it helps, AP can re-send the invoice once the exact PO/line item instructions are confirmed.

Thanks — appreciate your help,

Danielle Ross
Finance Lead | CloudBeacon Analytics
accounts-payable@cloudbeacon.com
Attachment: CloudBeacon_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Invoice_2026-03-28.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@cloudbeacon.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO needed for onboarding + invoice details

Hi Danielle —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Monica from procurement and Ben from Sales Ops so we can finalize PO issuance and the spend cap.

Quick answers / next steps:
- We'll issue a Redwood PO number and return the signed PO PDF to you.
- Standard payment terms are Net30 unless a different arrangement is negotiated; I'll confirm that with Finance.
- Regarding SKU-level breakdowns: our accounting prefers SKU/unit line items for each model/instance type when possible. Monica — can you confirm if we need our AP to receive a re-submitted invoice, or if procurement can accept the attached spreadsheet with annotations?

Danielle — if AP can re-send with the line-item splits (or a simple mapping sheet), that will speed processing.

I'll aim to get the PO out by EOD Monday if procurement confirms the spend cap.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO needed for onboarding + invoice details

Rachel / Ben —

Reviewed CloudBeacon's invoice and W-9. Procurement requires two actions before we can issue the PO:
1) Clarify the spend cap value to put on the PO. We typically put a buffer (5-10%) above the current invoice to allow for initial usage variance.
2) Split the invoice into separate line items for (a) Dedicated capacity reservation (GPU-hours) and (b) Support/Onboarding services. Each line item should include unit price, quantity, and total.

Karthik — can you confirm the finance-approved spend cap for this pilot? Ben — FYI this will be a reserved-capacity pilot tied to the DL-2026-0452 deal.

If CloudBeacon can resubmit the invoice with those two changes, procurement can move to PO issuance same day we receive it. Otherwise, we will generate a PO template and fill in provisional line items, but AP often requests a corrected invoice to match on their side.

Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement_po_template_fillable.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO needed for onboarding + invoice details

Monica / Rachel —

Finance signs off on a provisional spend cap of $48,000 for the first 30 days (pilot window). That includes a 5% buffer on the expected invoice amount. We can formalize higher committed spend if they convert to Dedicated on an annual reserved contract.

Please proceed with issuance once the invoice line items are corrected as requested. Also confirm that payment terms remain Net30 and include Redwood's remittance: Redwood Inference, PO # to be included on invoice, remit to: remit@redwoodinference.com (AP portal).

Karthik Iyer
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@cloudbeacon.com>, accounts-payable@cloudbeacon.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: PO-987654 issued + next steps for invoice line items (CloudBeacon onboarding)

Hi Danielle / AP team —

Thanks for your patience. Per procurement and finance sign-off, please find the issued PO and summary below:

- PO number: PO-987654 (attached PDF)
- Spend cap (pilot 30 days): $48,000 (includes 5% buffer)
- Payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt; please include the PO number on the invoice line; remit via Redwood AP portal or remit@redwoodinference.com
- Required invoice format: two separate line items —
    1) Dedicated capacity — SKU-level breakdown (model name, instance type, unit price, quantity, line total)
    2) Onboarding & support services — description, hours, rate, line total

Attachment: PO-987654_Redwood.pdf (PDF)

Danielle — can you have AP reissue the invoice with the SKU splits above? If it's easier, procurement attached a filled PO template that we can use to map their current invoice into the required fields. Once we receive the corrected invoice, procurement will confirm match and AP will route payment under PO-987654.

If you need the PO signed by a different approver or routed through DocuSign, let me know and I can escalate.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0186
